hero.title: Sarvakali
hero.lede: Devotion, magic, healing and insight, held in one place.

connect.title: Speak with Sarvakali
connect.lede: Share your name and a few times that suit you. Sarvakali confirms the meeting or suggests another time, and you meet over Google Meet.
connect.secondary: Not sure where to begin? Find your path

request.title: Request a time
request.text: Your name, email and a few times that suit you. Nothing about your situation.

confirm.title: Sarvakali confirms
confirm.text: The time is confirmed, or another one is suggested.

meet.title: Meet on Google Meet
meet.text: The link arrives by email. Join from your phone or computer.

pay.title: Pay by UPI
pay.text: An invoice with a UPI QR code. No card details, ever.

kind.title: From people who have sat with Sarvakali
kind.note: Sample words for the prototype. Real ones are shared only with each person's permission.

close.title: Every path begins with a conversation
